Tensions increased when law enforcement intercepted demonstrators en route to Jantar Mantar, resulting in the detention of 91 individuals, including political figures and MPs.

timeline.title: Nana Patekar's late-night message & what doctors revealed about hours that followed
timeline.description: Actor Nana Patekar was declared dead after being brought to Manipal Hospital in Goa. He sent a message to a friend indicating he was unwell before losing consciousness. Friends and a caretaker accompanied him when he was taken to the hospital. Medical staff attempted to revive him for nearly an hour but declared him dead upon arrival. His body has been sent for a post-mortem examination following a medico-legal case.

timeline.description: One point short of India’s 2018 Asian Games selection, Trap shooter Ahvar Rizvi spent the next seven years rebuilding his career after Double Trap was removed from the international programme. The 2018 junior world champion struggled with the transition, briefly quit shooting and later competed with teammate Lakshya Sheoran’s gun. Now, Rizvi has made his first Asian Games team and is preparing to represent India in Trap at Nagoya.

A demanding tournament schedule took its toll on performance, highlighting a stark decline from their previous edition's achievements.
